verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַבָּאִ֖ים מִצְרָ֑יְמָה אֵ֣ת יַעֲקֹ֔ב אִ֥ישׁ בָּֽאוּ׃ וּבֵית֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hab·bā·’îm miṣ·rā·yə·māh ’êṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’îš bā·’ū ū·ḇê·ṯōw
verses.literal: These are the names of the sons of Israel who went to Egypt with Jacob each - with his family

verses.original: רְאוּבֵ֣ן שִׁמְע֔וֹן לֵוִ֖י וִיהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’ū·ḇên šim·‘ō·wn lê·wî wî·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Reuben Simeon Levi and Judah

verses.original: יִשָּׂשכָ֥ר זְבוּלֻ֖ן וּבְנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·śā·š·ḵār zə·ḇū·lun ū·ḇə·nə·yå̄·min
verses.literal: Issachar Zebulun and Benjamin

verses.original: דָּ֥ן וְנַפְתָּלִ֖י גָּ֥ד וְאָשֵֽׁר׃
verses.transliteration: dān wə·nap̄·tā·lî gāḏ wə·’ā·šêr
verses.literal: Dan and Naphtali Gad and Asher

verses.original: נֶ֛פֶשׁ יַעֲקֹ֖ב יֹצְאֵ֥י יֶֽרֶךְ־ וַֽיְהִ֗י שִׁבְעִ֣ים כָּל־ נָ֑פֶשׁ וְיוֹסֵ֖ף הָיָ֥ה בְמִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ne·p̄eš ya·‘ă·qōḇ yō·ṣə·’ê ye·reḵ- way·hî šiḇ·‘îm kāl- nā·p̄eš wə·yō·w·sêp̄ hā·yāh ḇə·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: The descendants of Jacob . . . . . . numbered seventy in all . . . including Joseph who was already in Egypt

verses.original: יוֹסֵף֙ וְכָל־ אֶחָ֔יו וְכֹ֖ל הַהֽוּא׃ הַדּ֥וֹר וַיָּ֤מָת
verses.transliteration: yō·w·sêp̄ wə·ḵāl ’e·ḥāw wə·ḵōl ha·hū had·dō·wr way·yā·māṯ
verses.literal: Now Joseph and all his brothers and all that generation died

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל פָּר֧וּ וַֽיִּשְׁרְצ֛וּ וַיִּרְבּ֥וּ בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד וַיַּֽעַצְמ֖וּ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֹתָֽם׃פ וַתִּמָּלֵ֥א
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl pā·rū way·yiš·rə·ṣū way·yir·bū bim·’ōḏ mə·’ōḏ way·ya·‘aṣ·mū hā·’ā·reṣ ’ō·ṯām wat·tim·mā·lê
verses.literal: but the Israelites . . . were fruitful and increased rapidly they multiplied and became exceedingly . . . numerous so that the land . . . was filled with them

verses.original: חָדָ֖שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יָדַ֖ע אֶת־ יוֹסֵֽף׃ וַיָּ֥קָם עַל־ מִצְרָ֑יִם
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḏāš me·leḵ- ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏa‘ ’eṯ- yō·w·sêp̄ way·yā·qām ‘al- miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Then a new king who did not know - Joseph came to power in Egypt

verses.original: הִנֵּ֗ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֶל־ עַמּ֑וֹ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֚ם רַ֥ב וְעָצ֖וּם מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh way·yō·mer ’el- ‘am·mōw bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ‘am raḇ wə·‘ā·ṣūm mim·men·nū
verses.literal: Look he said to his people the Israelites . . . . . . [have become] too numerous and too powerful for us

verses.original: הָ֥בָה נִֽתְחַכְּמָ֖ה ל֑וֹ פֶּן־ יִרְבֶּ֗ה וְהָיָ֞ה כִּֽי־ מִלְחָמָה֙ תִקְרֶ֤אנָה הוּא֙ עַל־ וְנוֹסַ֤ף גַּם־ שֹׂ֣נְאֵ֔ינוּ וְנִלְחַם־ בָּ֖נוּ וְעָלָ֥ה מִן־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇāh niṯ·ḥak·kə·māh lōw pen- yir·beh wə·hā·yāh kî- mil·ḥā·māh ṯiq·re·nāh hū ‘al- wə·nō·w·sap̄ gam- śō·nə·’ê·nū wə·nil·ḥam- bā·nū wə·‘ā·lāh min- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Come let us deal shrewdly with them or they will increase even more and if . . . a war breaks out they . . . may join . . . our enemies fight against us and leave . . . the country

verses.original: וַיָּשִׂ֤ימוּ שָׂרֵ֣י מִסִּ֔ים עָלָיו֙ לְמַ֥עַן עַנֹּת֖וֹ בְּסִבְלֹתָ֑ם וַיִּ֜בֶן פִּתֹ֖ם וְאֶת־ רַעַמְסֵֽס׃ מִסְכְּנוֹת֙ עָרֵ֤י לְפַרְעֹ֔ה אֶת־
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śî·mū śā·rê mis·sîm ‘ā·lāw lə·ma·‘an ‘an·nō·ṯōw bə·siḇ·lō·ṯām way·yi·ḇen pi·ṯōm wə·’eṯ- ra·‘am·sês mis·kə·nō·wṯ ‘ā·rê lə·p̄ar·‘ōh ’eṯ-
verses.literal: So [the Egyptians] appointed taskmasters . . . over the Israelites to oppress them with forced labor As a result, they built Pithom - and Rameses as store cities for Pharaoh -

verses.original: וְכַאֲשֶׁר֙ יְעַנּ֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ כֵּ֥ן יִרְבֶּ֖ה וְכֵ֣ן יִפְרֹ֑ץ וַיָּקֻ֕צוּ מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵa·’ă·šer yə·‘an·nū ’ō·ṯōw kên yir·beh wə·ḵên yip̄·rōṣ way·yā·qu·ṣū mip·pə·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: - But the more they were oppressed - - the more they multiplied . . . and flourished so the Egyptians came to dread . . . the Israelites . . .

verses.original: וַיַּעֲבִ֧דוּ מִצְרַ֛יִם אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּפָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·ḇi·ḏū miṣ·ra·yim ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bə·p̄ā·reḵ
verses.literal: They worked . . . - the Israelites . . . ruthlessly

verses.original: חַיֵּיהֶ֜ם וַיְמָרְר֨וּ אֶת־ קָשָׁ֗ה בַּעֲבֹדָ֣ה וּבִלְבֵנִ֔ים בְּחֹ֙מֶר֙ וּבְכָל־ עֲבֹדָ֖ה בַּשָּׂדֶ֑ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־ עֲבֹ֣דָתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ עָבְד֥וּ בָהֶ֖ם בְּפָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥay·yê·hem way·mā·rə·rū ’eṯ- qā·šāh ba·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh ū·ḇil·ḇê·nîm bə·ḥō·mer ū·ḇə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh baś·śā·ḏeh ’êṯ kāl- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯām ’ă·šer- ‘ā·ḇə·ḏū ḇā·hem bə·p̄ā·reḵ
verses.literal: and made their lives bitter - with hard labor in brick and mortar and with all kinds of work in the fields - Every service - they imposed was harsh

verses.original: מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הָֽעִבְרִיֹּ֑ת לַֽמְיַלְּדֹ֖ת הָֽאַחַת֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שֵׁ֤ם שִׁפְרָ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית פּוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ miṣ·ra·yim way·yō·mer hā·‘iḇ·rî·yōṯ lam·yal·lə·ḏōṯ hā·’a·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer šêm šip̄·rāh wə·šêm haš·šê·nîṯ pū·‘āh
verses.literal: Then the king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives vvv whose names were Shiphrah . . . and Puah

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הָֽעִבְרִיּ֔וֹת בְּיַלֶּדְכֶן֙ אֶת־ וּרְאִיתֶ֖ן עַל־ הָאָבְנָ֑יִם אִם־ הוּא֙ בֵּ֥ן וַהֲמִתֶּ֣ן אֹת֔וֹ וְאִם־ הִ֖יא בַּ֥ת וָחָֽיָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hā·‘iḇ·rî·yō·wṯ bə·yal·leḏ·ḵen ’eṯ- ū·rə·’î·ṯen ‘al- hā·’ā·ḇə·nā·yim ’im- hū bên wa·hă·mit·ten ’ō·ṯōw wə·’im- hî baṯ wā·ḥā·yāh
verses.literal: - When you help the Hebrew women give birth - observe [them] on the birthstools If [the child] is a son kill him but if it is a daughter let her live

verses.original: הַֽמְיַלְּדֹת֙ אֶת־ וַתִּירֶ֤אןָ הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְלֹ֣א עָשׂ֔וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם דִּבֶּ֥ר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ן הַיְלָדִֽים׃ וַתְּחַיֶּ֖יןָ אֶת־
verses.transliteration: ham·yal·lə·ḏōṯ ’eṯ- wat·tî·re·nā hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·lō ‘ā·śū ka·’ă·šer me·leḵ miṣ·rā·yim dib·ber ’ă·lê·hen hay·lā·ḏîm wat·tə·ḥay·ye·nā ’eṯ-
verses.literal: The midwives, however - feared God and did not do as the king of Egypt had instructed . . . they let the boys live -

verses.original: מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ וַיִּקְרָ֤א לַֽמְיַלְּדֹ֔ת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ן מַדּ֥וּעַ עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ן הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה הַיְלָדִֽים׃ וַתְּחַיֶּ֖יןָ אֶת־
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ- miṣ·ra·yim way·yiq·rā lam·yal·lə·ḏōṯ way·yō·mer lā·hen mad·dū·a‘ ‘ă·śî·ṯen had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh hay·lā·ḏîm wat·tə·ḥay·ye·nā ’eṯ-
verses.literal: So the king of Egypt summoned the midwives and asked them Why have you done . . . this Why have you let the boys live -

verses.original: הַֽמְיַלְּדֹת֙ וַתֹּאמַ֤רְןָ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה הָֽעִבְרִיֹּ֑ת כִּֽי־ לֹ֧א הַמִּצְרִיֹּ֖ת כַנָּשִׁ֛ים כִּ֣י הֵ֔נָּה חָי֣וֹת וְיָלָֽדוּ׃ בְּטֶ֨רֶם הַמְיַלֶּ֖דֶת תָּב֧וֹא אֲלֵהֶ֛ן
verses.transliteration: ham·yal·lə·ḏōṯ wat·tō·mar·nā ’el- par·‘ōh hā·‘iḇ·rî·yōṯ kî- lō ham·miṣ·rî·yōṯ ḵan·nā·šîm kî hên·nāh ḥā·yō·wṯ wə·yā·lā·ḏū bə·ṭe·rem ham·yal·le·ḏeṯ tā·ḇō·w ’ă·lê·hen
verses.literal: The midwives answered . . . Pharaoh The Hebrew women . . . are not like the Egyptian women for they are vigorous and give birth before a midwife arrives . . .

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַיֵּ֥יטֶב לַֽמְיַלְּדֹ֑ת הָעָ֛ם וַיִּ֧רֶב מְאֹֽד׃ וַיַּֽעַצְמ֖וּ
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yê·ṭeḇ lam·yal·lə·ḏōṯ hā·‘ām way·yi·reḇ mə·’ōḏ way·ya·‘aṣ·mū
verses.literal: So God was good to the midwives and the people multiplied and became even more numerous

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כִּֽי־ הַֽמְיַלְּדֹ֖ת אֶת־ יָֽרְא֥וּ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיַּ֥עַשׂ לָהֶ֖ם בָּתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî- ham·yal·lə·ḏōṯ ’eṯ- yā·rə·’ū hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·ya·‘aś lā·hem bāt·tîm
verses.literal: - And because the midwives - feared God He gave them families of their own

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֔ה וַיְצַ֣ו לְכָל־ עַמּ֖וֹ לֵאמֹ֑ר כָּל־ הַבֵּ֣ן הַיִּלּ֗וֹד תַּשְׁלִיכֻ֔הוּ הַיְאֹ֙רָה֙ וְכָל־ הַבַּ֖ת תְּחַיּֽוּן׃ס
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh way·ṣaw lə·ḵāl ‘am·mōw lê·mōr kāl- hab·bên hay·yil·lō·wḏ taš·lî·ḵu·hū hay·’ō·rāh wə·ḵāl hab·baṯ tə·ḥay·yūn
verses.literal: Then Pharaoh commanded all his people . . . Every son born [to the Hebrews] you must throw into the Nile but every daughter you may allow to live
